One more tooth on the rear sprocket makes every gear about 2.0% shorter; one less on the front about 8.3% shorter.

records.notes: Worked out from Yamaha's published primary ratio 3.368, gearbox ratios and final drive 13/50: speed = rpm / (primary x gear x final) x tire circumference. Multiply by rpm/1,000 for a given engine speed.
